defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.what: English library heading read 'Form' while the section tab reads 'Forms'
defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.cause: the Agent app's context-kind table registers the source '表单' -> 'Form' first and the catalogue keeps the first wording; the library heading reused that generic source
defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.fix: the heading uses the library's own source '表单库' (Forms / 表單庫, same as the tab); the Forms catalogue's '表单' entry now says 'Form' like every other catalogue (it labels one form in the request dialog)

defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.cause: one combined message with two numbers cannot pluralise; plural forms were also only chosen by a `count` parameter that call sites such as '{n} 步' never pass, so '1 steps' was possible
defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.fix: two plural messages joined with a separator; the shared translator chooses the plural form by `count` or else by the only numeric parameter (test added)

defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.what: workspace switcher option started with ' · ' for a workspace without an organization
defects_found_and_fixed_in_this_round.fix: the separator is only written when there is an owner prefix (personal / organization name)

re_proof: the walkthrough was re-run on the rebuilt bundle (127.0.0.1:33951) after the fixes; screenshots in this directory are from that run and show 'Forms' / '表單庫', '1 submission' and the switcher without the leading separator
